experiment.comment: The "temperature" property in dg1 refers to the nominal temperatures of the data points, that is, the temperatures of the isothermal zones of the reactor (K). The residence time is also for the isothermal zone of the reactor.

In the Supp. Mat., there are experimental results for the first four nominal temperatures (1073, 1123, 1173, 1223 K), however, no experimental temperature profiles are published for these data points. Therefore, the nominal temperatures are used for the simulation of these data points. As practically no NH3 conversion was observed below 1300 K, the lack of experimental temperature profiles should not cause errors in these cases.

Volumetric flow rates under normal (reference) conditions were calculated based on the FR Inlet flow data given in the Supplementary Material as follows: Q_tot = Q_NH3_in + Q_O2_in + Q_He_tot_in. All pressure values in the FR Inlet flow data were corrected to 950 torr before calculating the inlet flow rates.
